description: The Geothermal Data Repository (GDR) is the U.S. Department of Energy's open repository for geothermal data generated by DOE-funded projects, hosted on OpenEI, offering research, collaboration and transparency through free access. The home page reports 1,421 datasets from 146 data providers, 764 TB of data and more than 73 million total downloads, with browsing by direct use, EGS, FORGE and hydrothermal categories. Featured collections include the Utah FORGE project, the EGS Collab project of intermediate-scale field test beds, the Geothermal Play Fairway Analysis project that maps favourable heat, permeability and fluid intersections, and data lakes of curated datasets. Users can find or submit data. Coverage is mainly the United States. Access: free web search and downloads, with DOIs on individual submissions; the site footer states CC BY 4.0 for OpenEI content unless otherwise noted on a submission. Caveats: counts are those shown on the home page on the reading date, and each submission carries its own terms. It suits geothermal resource and district heating feasibility studies, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
